name: groundwork
description: Turns a feature ticket into an agreed plan on a tldraw canvas: maps today's code, finds the gaps, draws the process flows, settles every decision with you one at a time, then builds the plan and mockups from real components.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a feature on a tldraw canvas before any spec or code.
interface.longDescription: Name a feature and Groundwork maps how the code works today, lays out a Discovery canvas (overview, gaps with file:line evidence, process flows, a behaviour matrix, decisions and follow-ups), and walks you through every gap and decision one at a time until each is agreed. Only then does it build a Plan page (data, behaviour, pages) and realistic mockups from the project's real components, ready to hand to your spec workflow.
defaultPrompt: Plan multi-location support before we write any specs.
Find the gaps in the logic for this ticket and draw its process flows.
Pick up the discovery canvas where we left off.
